The '''Pahum Cultural Center''' was a building located in the heart of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. A home to many of the [[City/Legends|city's]] exhibitions, it was also a performance venue. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|duel]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] took place outside the Pahum Cultural Center.
